question: How many episodes of the Jujutsu Kaisen anime use "SPECIALZ" as their opening theme?
answer:
**18 episodes**: Season 2, episodes 6–23 (overall episodes 30–47).

SPECIALZ by King Gnu is the opening for the Shibuya Incident arc, which began on August 31, 2023 and runs 18 episodes ([Anime Corner](https://animecorner.me/king-gnu-to-perform-jujutsu-kaisen-season-2-shibuya-incident-arc-opening-song/), [Sportskeeda](https://www.sportskeeda.com/anime/news-jujutsu-kaisen-season-2-reveals-shibuya-arc-s-theme-song)). I didn't find an episode guide that confirms the range. The count assumes every episode in the arc played the opening, so an episode that skipped it would lower the number.
